انتفضت (form VIII)

# اِنْتَفَضْتَ (intafaḍta) /in.ta.fadˤ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# اِنْتَفَضْتِ (intafaḍti) /in.ta.fadˤ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْتَفَضَ (intafaḍa)
# اِنْتَفَضَتْ (intafaḍat) /in.ta.fa.dˤat/: third-p
